summary.headline: ACN insider buying is the one clear signal; MPC's 7.5% drop is unexplained
summary.summary: Biggest threat to a holding is MPC, which fell about 7.5% on 10/27 with no identified cause and only a small pre-market bounce, so find the driver before the open. SHOP reports Nov 3, so earnings risk dominates the coming week with no directional edge. The strongest new signal is ACN, where the chair/CEO and a director bought about $3.2M after a ~4.9% drop, a modest bullish read. PSX filed Q3 results (headline $5.6B earnings) but adjusted figures, guidance and price reaction are not yet known. CRWD shows heavy 10b5-1 insider selling against a rising stock; CRL, ILMN and TEAM are largely unchanged, and ADI and VLO had only routine filings.
actions: Find why MPC dropped 7.5% on 10/27 before deciding to hold or trim.
Check PSX adjusted EPS, guidance and pre-market reaction against the $5.6B headline.
Decide SHOP sizing ahead of the Nov 3 earnings report.
